tts_summary: Hey there! Thor is moving through that exciting adolescent month—11-month-old Pitbulls are affectionate, athletic, and often testing boundaries as they grow into their strength. Puppies around this age typically show surges of energy, continued chewing or teething behaviors, and a strong drive to learn and please, but you may also hit brief fear or testing periods. You know how rescues can be extra loyal once trust builds; with Thor's loving nature this is prime time for consistent recall work and controlled play in the yard, especially during warm weather. Here's the thing: this month's mix of high-protein food, rotating training treats, and a few one-time safety and enrichment items fits his needs. Check recommendations below to fine-tune anything for Thor.
